recognize_zh: MUM1 染色下幾乎所有腫瘤細胞核呈強而一致的棕色核染色（伴隨淡淡細胞質暈染），只有零星小的背景細胞為陰性；大量 MUM1/IRF4 陽性代表漿細胞分化程式，符合漿母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Strong diffuse nuclear MUM1/IRF4 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Some cytoplasmic blush accompanying the nuclear staining
Tumor cells large with round nuclei, densely packed in sheets
Few scattered negative small cells (stromal/endothelial, reactive) as internal negative control
describe_en: MUM1/IRF4 immunostain shows strong, diffuse nuclear positivity in virtually all neoplastic cells, with a light cytoplasmic blush. Rare interspersed small stromal and endothelial nuclei are negative. Diffuse MUM1 expression indicates a late B-cell/plasma cell differentiation program. In a CD20-negative, EBER-positive large cell neoplasm, this supports EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ABC-type DLBCL is also MUM1 positive but retains CD20/PAX5 and lacks CD138 and diffuse EBER.
Myeloma is diffusely MUM1 positive too, and is separated by clinical/serologic context, lower Ki-67 and usual EBER negativity.
PEL shares MUM1/CD138 expression but is HHV8 (LANA) positive.
Melanoma can be MUM1 positive, which is excluded by S100/SOX10/HMB45 positivity and CD138/EBER negativity.
